display_title: Legacy of the Skipped Hero: Second Class Ascendant
description:
Douji, a renowned marksman specialist and the top strategist in gaming, known for skipping through content at double speed and ignoring anything not summarized in three lines, decides to take on the challenge of Ferrer, which is a game of "Land of Hardship" in the gaming world. Despite his usual nonchalant approach, Douji finds himself forcefully transitioned into the hidden class of "Skip Warrior" within the perilous depths of Ferrerus, where even gamers who can't spare a moment for footnotes tremble. With this melee-oriented hidden class, can Douji reclaim his former glory and ascend once more to the top rank?
